entities.name: Halo
entities.description: An iridescent magical substance of angelic essence that rules New Capenna's criminal world, enhancing magic, curing, and protecting against phyresis.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A lost angel whose corporeal form was restored with Halo.

entities.name: Luxior
entities.description: Elspeth Tirel's sword, infused with Halo.

entities.name: Angels of New Capenna
entities.description: Said to have built New Capenna before the demons trapped them and converted their bodies into Halo.

entities.name: Demon Lords
entities.description: Betrayed the angels, used Halo to defeat the Phyrexians, then disappeared.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: Kept Halo flowing with a new supply unveiled at Crescendo.

entities.name: Adversary
entities.description: Has been hoarding Halo to monopolize it.

events.summary: The demons betray the angels after New Capenna's completion, trapping them in stasis to convert their bodies into Halo.
events.quote: after its completion the demons betrayed the angels, trapping them in a kind of stasis

events.summary: The Demon Lords use Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappear.
events.quote: The Demon Lords used Halo to defeat the Phyrexians and then disappeared themselves.

events.summary: The Adversary hoards Halo to monopolize it while the Cabaretti keep it flowing with a new supply unveiled at Crescendo.
events.quote: the Cabaretti have kept the Halo flowing through a new supply

events.summary: Halo impedes the intruders of the New Phyrexian Invasion, keeping Capenna's defenders safe.
events.quote: It impeded the intruders during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
